run_extract_imagenet_lvis: run the script to extract ImageNet-21K tar files listed in a wnid text file to a destination directory
run_extract_with_custom_paths: run the script with custom src_path, dst_path, and data_path arguments to extract specific tar archives
run_list_wnid_extraction: run the script to iterate over a wnid list and extract each corresponding tar file from ImageNet-21K
run_batch_tar_extraction: run the script to batch extract multiple tar files from a source directory into organized subdirectories
run_imagenet_subset_extraction: run the script to extract a subset of ImageNet-21K data filtered by LVIS class identifiers
